limitations: Selected source snapshots are not all transitive build/tool inputs.
No compiled-object disassembly or CPU dispatch attestation.
No WAN, global CPU, real speech, recognition-quality or allocation-count claim.
Legacy timings are fidelity side effects, not adoption measurements.
Parser rejects >=10% total regression for ANY signal in EITHER pair.
Allowlisted environment values are not recorded or equality-attested.
External Cargo config lstat checks do not eliminate concurrent-change races.
No guarantee of bit identity for all possible audio
Historical CLI live success does not qualify this new build variant
Archive/command metadata is not object-code or runtime dispatch attestation
Downstream crates/outside --manifest-path invocations do not inherit this repository Cargo env.
VS17 hosted check is functional only; its archive hash is checkout-specific and not comparable across machines.
The original local Windows release CLI was not rebuilt or invoked; CI builds separate checkout artifacts. No live-service validation of this variant was performed.
Full CI qualification is functional; it does not establish cross-platform performance or validate alternative VS generators independently.
